verdict.rationale: Missive publishes an llms.txt index at https://missiveapp.com/docs/llms.txt, and content has been fetched from that URL. Every docs page also serves raw Markdown when `.md` is appended to its URL, which gives agents clean, agent-oriented documentation to read. The probe's 404 at the root /llms.txt shows only that the file sits under /docs rather than the site root; it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: an llms.txt at the conventional site root (discoverability), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
